name: SBI Platinum Jubilee Asha Scholarship 2026-27 (School / UG / PG / Medical / IIT / IIM)
provider: SBI Foundation (CSR arm of State Bank of India)

rules.value: UG/PG: top 300 NIRF institutes or NAAC A and above; Medical: AIIMS or top 50 NIRF medical colleges; IIT: top 23 IITs; IIM
rules.quote: Applicants must be pursuing an undergraduate course (any year) from a premier university/college in India, as listed in the Top 300 Institutes according to the latest NIRF rankings.
Students must have secured 7.5 CGPA/75% marks or above in their previous academic year.
There is a provision of 10% relaxation for students belonging to SC/ST (percentage of marks = 65.5–75%, CGPA = 6.5 and above).
There is a provision of 15% relaxation for students belonging to PwdB (percentage of marks = 60%, CGPA = 6.00 and above).
The gross annual family income of the applicants must be up to INR 6,00,000.
The gross annual family income of the applicants must be up to INR 3,00,000.

rules.value: 50% of slots reserved for female students
rules.quote: 50% of the total slots are reserved for female students (across all categories: SC, ST, OBC, and General).

amount.text: School Rs 15,000; UG Rs 75,000; PG Rs 1,50,000; Medical Rs 2,00,000; IIT Rs 2,00,000; IIM Rs 5,00,000 (renewable subject to eligibility)
amount.quote: SBI strives to extend its financial support to students throughout their course.

documents.name: Marksheets previous and latest year
documents.quote: Marksheets from the previous and latest year (Class 10 / 12 / semester marksheets, as applicable).

documents.name: Aadhaar and photograph
documents.quote: A government-issued photo ID such as Aadhaar, plus a recent passport-size photograph.

documents.name: Family income proof and SBI passbook
documents.quote: Family income proof (income certificate / Form 16A / salary slips) and an SBI bank passbook.

documents.name: Bonafide/admission proof and fee receipt
documents.quote: Bonafide or admission proof from your institution and the latest fee receipt or fee structure.

documents.name: Caste certificate, family photograph
documents.quote: Caste certificate for reserved categories and a home / family photograph of the applicant.

deadline.quote: Last date to complete and submit the scholarship application.
